text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

Both you and the successful candidate are women, making sex discrimination exceptionally improbable. An all-women panel selecting one woman over another does not indicate gender bias. Raising the panel's gender composition would appear baseless and damage your professional reputation.

The decision likely hinged on non-technical criteria: the announcement highlighted "excellent client relationships," indicating the panel prioritized business development and stakeholder management over total years of design experience. For head-of-group positions, interpersonal skills and commercial strategy often outweigh technical seniority. 

Rather than mentioning panel demographics, follow up politely on your request for constructive feedback, focusing specifically on how you can strengthen client development and leadership competencies for future leadership opportunities.
